Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document ChEMBL ID. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls for missing structures. Return the result set sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID.
